Telescope 4.4 can stream from webcams and capture cards next to your phones and the phone app gets a Black screen button.

## New

**Webcams and capture cards.** A webcam plugged into your computer now shows up in the phone list under its own name and streams like a phone would, with every effect and a virtual camera of its own. Its Webcam card has the resolutions and frame rates the camera supports and whichever of its own settings it has, like focus, exposure time, gain, white balance or anti-flicker. Cameras with a USB webcam mode and anything going through an HDMI capture card work the same way. That covers plenty of DSLRs and mirrorless cameras too. I tested it with a Logitech C920 and an HP webcam on Linux. On Windows it was only tested in a VM since I don't have a Windows PC, so please report anything odd there.

**Black screen on the phone.** A **Black screen** button next to **Preview** turns the phone's screen black while the camera keeps streaming, like the one Browser camera already had. Tap once to see the status and tap again to wake it. It saves battery on OLED screens and helps on phones whose power saving closes Telescope even with battery optimisation turned off.

## Changed

- The plugins from 4.3 are now translated into all six languages.
- **UDP on Wi-Fi** moved from the Connection card to the Streaming tab in Settings. It can stutter more than TCP on a lot of networks and it was too easy to switch on without knowing that. If you had it on it stays on.
